pitch.hero: Wren, who means to become a warden of the enchanted Thornwood
pitch.want: to cross the whole Thornwood between dawn and dusk and be named a warden at the Far Gate

pitch.ending_kind: gauntlet: one true line to a naming at the gate; every other way ends in a setback

truth.question: How is the Thornwood Trial passed?
truth.statement: The Trial is passed only by keeping to the true warden mark, which always runs the hardest line, through the Bramble Maze, Sunken Grove, Beast-Warren, Elder-Tree Council, Far Ridge and Far Gate within one day. Easy ways, strange lights, shortcuts, false marks and haste all end the Trial for the season; old warden runs are bold shortcuts that rejoin the trail. At the gate Wren is named a warden by presenting openly and answering, or earns a lesser place by the wild ways.

wren_hero.text: The reader is Wren, addressed as you.

wren_wants_warden.text: Wren means to become a warden of the Thornwood today.

thornwood_enchanted.text: The Thornwood is an enchanted forest.

trial_horn.text: The Trial horn sounds long and low at the eaves of the forest to start the Trial.

trial_one_day.text: The Trial gives one day, dawn to dusk, to cross the whole wood and reach the far gate before the light dies.

four_ways_in.text: Four ways lead in: the old deer track, the dry stream bed, the charcoal-burners road and the broken boundary wall.

took_deer_track.text: Wren came in by the old deer track, quiet and half-hidden.

took_stream_bed.text: Wren came in by the dry stream bed, making quick time on pale gravel.

took_road.text: Wren came in by the wide, rutted charcoal-burners road, out in the open.

took_wall.text: Wren came in through the broken boundary wall and dropped onto the maze mouth from above.

maze_mouth_knot.text: Every way into the Thornwood ties together at the maze mouth, a knot of thorn paths.

day_barely_begun.text: The day has barely begun when Wren reaches the maze.

warden_marks_on_trunks.text: Warden marks are scratched or cut into the tree trunks, pointing every wrong way and the single right one.

true_mark_hardest.text: The true warden mark always runs the hardest line; the wider, gentler way is easy and wrong.

strange_light_warning.text: A light that does not belong in the wood is a warning, not a welcome.

warden_runs_exist.text: Wide old warden runs branch off the marked spine as bold shortcuts that can save daylight or strand a walker.

false_marks_exist.text: Some warden marks are false, cut long ago by beaten walkers, and lead the hopeful astray.

light_failing.text: The daylight is failing and dusk is coming on.

legs_tiring.text: Wren's legs are beginning to tire.

marks_scarce.text: Deep in the stretch the warden marks grow scarce and the ground turns treacherous.

strange_sound.text: A strange sound draws at Wren from off the marked line.

badly_spent.text: Wren is badly spent near the end of the stretch.

wren_off_marks.text: Wren has left the true warden line for a wrong way that will not open.

wren_rejoined_trail.text: The warden run delivered Wren back onto the marked spine with daylight saved.

searchers_coming.text: Searchers will come for Wren at first light.

trial_lost.text: Wren has failed the Trial and must wait for next season to try again.

trial_horns_end.text: Horns sound at dusk across the trees to end the Trial.

wren_met_creatures.text: Wren has met the creatures of the wood during the day.

grove_first_warden.text: The first warden of the whole Trial waits in the Sunken Grove; no warden tests Wren before it.

warren_lynx_warden.text: A great lynx-warden paces its ledge above the Beast-Warren.

warren_mercy_test.text: The lynx-warden watches to see whether Wren will fight, flee, or show it mercy.

council_wardens.text: Three hooded wardens sit in judgement among the elder tree's roots.

council_second_test.text: The Elder-Tree Council holds the second warden test of the Trial, a test of judgement.

ridge_third_test.text: The Far Ridge holds the third warden test, a test of raw nerve, high above the forest.

gate_scene.text: The Far Gate stands black against the last red band of dusk with its heavy warden bar drawn fast.

gate_final_test.text: The Far Gate holds the final test of the Trial and Wren's time is nearly gone.

gate_outer_wall.text: The Far Gate is set in an outer wall that is crumbling.

arrived_gate_dusk.text: Wren reaches the Far Gate just as the last horn dies, with the bar still drawn.

gate_three_wardens.text: Three wardens stand in the gateway, waiting to judge how Wren ran the whole Trial.

wild_ways_exist.text: Besides the gate there is another way to cross, called the wild ways.

head_warden_question.text: The head warden asks Wren to account for the day and name the one thing that carried Wren through.

wren_showed_beasts_mercy.text: Wren spared the warren beasts and showed them mercy when Wren might have struck at them.

wren_named_warden.text: Wren is named a warden of the Thornwood, the bar lifts and the gate swings open.

head_warden_she.text: The head warden is a woman who lays a green cord across Wren's shoulders.

wren_crossed_in_time.text: Wren crossed the entire Thornwood within the single day.

wren_named_wild_warden.text: The wardens name Wren a warden of the wild ways, with honour, for mercy shown to the beasts.

honesty_first_mark.text: Honesty is the very first mark the wardens look for; they laugh kindly at the answer of luck.

wren_latecomer.text: Wren arrived as a latecomer, and the great bar is not drawn for latecomers.

wild_ways_lesser_place.text: The wild ways are a harder crossing walked alone through the dark that earns a lesser place among the outer wardens.

wren_outer_warden.text: Wren walked the wild ways through the night and at dawn earned a real place among the outer wardens.

wren_refused_wild_ways.text: Wren refused the lesser crossing and set off home to try the whole Trial again next season.

wren_caught_slipping.text: The wardens caught Wren trying to slip the gate in the dark, and a Trial ended by sneaking is no pass.

wren_sank_down.text: Wren sank down spent before the gate and let the last horn die; the bar did not lift.

maze_scene.text: At the heart of the Bramble Maze four thorn paths knot together.

grove_scene.text: In the Sunken Grove drowned stone wardens stand knee-deep in black water and the true mark leads through the cold flood.

warren_scene.text: The Beast-Warren is a tangle of dens and dug tunnels.

council_scene.text: A vast elder tree fills the whole hollow of the Elder-Tree Council.

ridge_scene.text: The Far Ridge is a wind-scoured spine of rock climbing toward the last of the light.

maze_temptations.text: At the Bramble Maze a wider gentle way, a strange light and a narrow shortcut all tempt Wren off the true mark.

maze_warden_run.text: An old warden run in the Bramble Maze strikes over root and deadfall as a shortcut.

maze_hazard2.text: In the Bramble Maze the briar closes overhead until the trunks lose every warden sign.

maze_hazard3.text: In the Bramble Maze an old deer-run forks and forks again into a blind tangle of hedge.

maze_hazard4.text: In the Bramble Maze the hooked cane drags at Wren's sleeves and the true path disappears behind.
